stem: A test could reliably detect only lifts of 20% relative or more. It ends with +3% relative, and the result is not significant. Which conclusion fits?

options.text: The change has no real effect on conversion, so the idea can now be dropped for good
A very large effect is unlikely, but smaller ones worth having are not ruled out
The change works, since a positive lift of 3% relative was observed
The test proves that the true effect lies between 0% and 20% relative
